notes.title: Halloween Discount, Team GK at Philippines ESGS, and a new spoopy trailer!
notes.content:
Sorry for being busy recently. Alex needed the time to do some external work to pay his bills and rents. Hopefully, by next month we'll go full force on GK again!

Now off to some news!

[h1]💀 A new trailer for Good Knight! 💀[/h1]
Good Knight has grown a lot the last year, but we still don't have much budget. XD We did want to make more marketing materials and so on to help advertise the game. So Alex remixed Good Knight trailers in a way to make it more spoopy and funnier as how the game has been more loved recently. I hope it'll entice more people to play our beloved game
[previewyoutube=Da3-9SI2ZWw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]📢 Spoopier Price! 📢[/h1]
It is Halloween and we decided to do a price drop for Good Knight~
Our game is a love letter to many Halloween-related stuff as well so it's the perfect time to play Good Knight if you haven't!

[h1]💓 Games for the people! 💓[/h1]
It's ESGS week! We invite you to say hello! We're proud how grassroots we are to our community!
It's very FGC-ish. <3
As stated on the photo Good knight has been on the Phillipines gaming scene for a while now. Dozens of events even! And we can't wait to meet more people this weekend!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37587014/f3f0dcd5eed60ea4ce626f167f703508f29a1975.png[/img]

notes.title: The fan favorite OST is now on Steam and 40% OFF!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37587014/7b5c0be836de234d23b244926645738d99afe481.jpg[/img]
The fan favorite Good Knight OST by LEAF XCEED Music Division is available in MP3 320 CBR now on Steam! Get it NOW 40% off during its launch!

“Did I mention that the music goes harder than the demons of hell?”
The Bone Zone

“I’m sure many would agree when I say that the music of this game is the best part of it. It’s described as a metal soundtrack on the game’s store page, and it accompanies the gameplay and the art style of the game perfectly, hyping you up to go against more and more bosses and levels. I genuinely believe that without the music and sound design, the game would not be played to its truest form.”
POP! by INQUIRER

“We also can't talk about Good Knight without mentioning the absolutely rockin' tracks. Some of the best I've ever heard since Lords of Thunder and Ys, and that was a long time ago. They're like a mix between those games and some of ZUN's work on Touhou -- mixing classical instruments with hard rock and speed metal. Just amazing music that you have to hear, and it's perfect for the game. I'm telling you now, it's next-level shit, and it'll have you looking to buy that soundtrack.”
Shmup Junkie

notes.title: Good Knight is part of The Nightmarket Festival in Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Good Knight is part of The Nightmarket Festival in Steam![/h1]
The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!
The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. 
The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.

notes.title: Halloween Sale 25% off, join the bullet hell adventure with us NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 6 is released![/h1]
[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Auto Save -- The Geekositymag, Zeke and Sakurami Ruby patch! Auto Save and resume is finally added in the game. Resuming a game will not allow you to join the leaderboards, but its very nice for streamers and players who dont have time to play.
[*] Multiplayer -- The HoshiLovi Patch! (They'll hate me for this XD) Because they were playing too "okay" and game was too balanced. XD Made multiplayer abit more harder. Before when only 1 player is left, that player will be as strong as single player fire rate wise. Now its abit weaker. This is so that players cannot fully rely on a strong player.
[*] Score Improvement -- The IssaKimchi Patch! Combo Multipliers now halfs rather than going to 1x when dying in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] The usual updated credits, death cards, texts
[*] Fixed background story bugs
[*] Xychi patch - Added keys for F,V,N and T
[*] Certain easter eggs now properly show up at 150 rather than 152
[*] Added tap count on rhythm in the endscreen
[*] Added new chicken easter egg
[*] Added more gamefeel for the  rhythm
[*] Removed chromatic abberation in title screen for people that has sensitive eyes [/list]

This is the 6th patch already since the release.
We'll be hoping to be used to posting the patches here in steam. :D
